name: every-corner
description: Make Claude Code work like a senior developer: tour any codebase in plain English, get interviewed before building so features land right the first time, and see every risky command explained before you approve it.

safetynet.title: Safety-net hook
safetynet.description: Warn before dangerous shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE and more) with a plain-English explanation and a safer option. Safe commands are never interrupted.
